about: The instrument spells no family of the store: the writer that vouches a source and the family a source is named in are words bound's own lock names, and the wire lists; bound reads them there.
A role is read the one way topos reads it, from the lines that give it, whether a leaf-role line or a region's role; bound never spells the family of the line that gave it.
What bound says of what it did names sources, renders and regions, never the words a lock may change.

cases.name: the vouched sources, read through the words bound's own lock names
the regions a fold names from roles
a bound whose own lock names no word for its store
cases.refused: bound: REFUSE·wire `` is not one of `audit/wire/families`

red was: bound spelled the store's families in its own code, 25 times across 14 modules: a lock that renamed a family would have been read through words it no longer said
